title: Falling into the Abyss of the Dead
summary: At the Abyss of the Dead, Lin Feng holds Lu Xueqi with a binding spell until Zhang Xiaofan frees her. Nian Laoda unleashes his Red Devil Eyes, which suppress Lu Xueqi's Tianxie Sword, but Xiaofan's stick holds it back. Nian Laoda knocks Xiaofan over the edge; Lu Xueqi catches his hand, refuses to let go, and both fall into the abyss. Fen Xiang and Tian Yin reinforcements destroy the Hall's weapon forge, and the Blood-Refining Hall pulls back, saying two righteous disciples are dead. At the bottom, Lu Xueqi finds herself in a sealed cave with the badly hurt Xiaofan and fights off creatures until she collapses. Xiaofan wakes and heals her. Bi Yao and You Ji then arrive looking for the Dixue Cave, decide to take the two captive for the Ghost King's side, and the episode ends as something huge appears.
